title: An isolated T1 deposit survives a crash

steps.text: Headless T1 uses t1v01; playable default T1 uses isolated t1v02 rooms. The room manager retains exclusive authority until closing is durable and fences reconnects after a refused close, protecting existing rooms too.
The server binds a request to the authenticated player and issued epoch. Reach and cadence are host facts. A bounded receipt window prevents retries from spending twice.
Before publishing a stamp, the existing sync durably replaces a verified checkpoint plus its ordered future queue. Refused writes pause production; a bad load is never served as fresh progress.
Apply transfers only available cargo into the fixed 24-log bill. At 23/24, competing four-log offers move one then zero. That one transfer starts one funded job, independently of any animation.
Restart verifies the envelope and replays the stored tail once. Bounded offline completion advances only funded work. Persistent personal carry and shared drops remain in the conservation equation.

The separate personal-profile contract writes a claim and cosmetic together under a shared browser Web Lock. The adapter rebuilds verified progress; a snapshot cannot replay success effects or grant another claim.
